title: MindMelt
description:
Hello, Sweeteas!
This weeks file is short and simple, but immensely effective and fun for fans of hypno and trance.
I take you down deep into those wonderful waters of trance you so love and…change the way you experience trance. If you listen to this, trance will change. Trance will become a goal all on its own, decoupled from any suggestions or objectives. Trance will be enough on its own to light the fires of your arousal and make you feel all nice and happy and relaxed.
Listen to this only if you want all trance from this day forward to be linked strongly with arousal, anticipation, and warm, pleasant tingles of the body and the mind.
There is no wakener. You can just drift and drift and drift when it ends.
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
RAW: usually just a plain recording, with no effects whatsoever, except for when binaurals are specified.
SFX: with sound effects, like echoes, panning, 3D, environmental effects, and all sorts of fun stuff.
Some files have many versions you can chooses from, while others are more sparse.
There is only one version of this file: SFX.
